_meta.description: Known robustly-over-constrained (task, mode) cells that fail Scenic rejection sampling even at the 55000 eval ceiling across multiple seeds. Documented as a §6 criterion-6 caveat of the open-ended distribution rather than masked with an ever-larger budget. Source: validation_run3 g3 budget triage (rca/g3_budget_triage.md sec. 5-6).
_meta.remediation: documented exemption; NOT a forced pass and NOT a budget bump
_meta.estimated_population_note: upper bound; ~8 high-geometric-cardinality cells per task. The bowl_on_stove family is high-variance (straddles the ceiling) and is recovered by the bounded resample-on-RejectionException retry, so true-infeasible count is lower.

cells.note: recovered by the bounded resample-on-RejectionException retry; not infeasible
